title: Atlas DataFlow Build Pipeline Source Contract Input
description: Minimum controlled input accepted by the build pipeline before candidate artifact generation begins. This schema governs what the build entrypoint reads and validates before any derivation starts. Implicit local file paths, raw notebooks, secrets, and private paths are prohibited as input values. Fields in this schema map to dataset_identity, release_identity, and source_run in pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json. Project Spec S0167 evolved this schema purely additively (new optional properties only, same schema_version const, existing required array unchanged) to add an optional capability-aware bridge into the Project Spec S0166 dataset-integration authoring contract family (pipeline/dataset-integration-authoring-manifest.schema.json, pipeline/capability-profile.schema.json). Historical source-contract-input.v1 behavior is preserved explicitly: an instance using only the original required fields remains valid and is interpreted exactly as before.

safe_relative_reference.description: Portable, repository-relative reference. Rejects absolute POSIX paths, Windows drive paths, UNC/backslash paths, parent traversal, empty and dot-only paths, and repeated separators. Never an absolute external scientific-analysis project root.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the source contract input. Used by the build entrypoint to verify input compatibility before validation begins. Unchanged by Project Spec S0167 -- the capability-aware fields below are additive and optional, not a new version.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset identifier. Maps to pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json#/properties/dataset_identity/properties/dataset_slug. Pattern matches the candidate layout slug convention exactly to prevent drift. Must not be inferred from a local filesystem path, fixture name, or directory name.

release_id.description: Release identifier for this candidate build. Maps to pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json#/properties/release_identity/properties/release_id. Pattern matches the candidate layout release_id convention exactly.

source_contract_ref.description: Explicit, reviewable reference to the human-authored source contract that governs the dataset study. Informs pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json#/properties/source_run traceability. Must be a relative, reviewable reference — not an absolute path (paths starting with '/' are prohibited), a raw local path to a private file, or a runtime-generated path. Example of a safe value: 'contracts/runtime-contract.schema.json'.

source_data_ref.description: Explicit reference to the source dataset or study used for this build. Informs pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json#/properties/source_run traceability. Must be an explicit, reviewable identifier — not an implicit local filesystem path (paths starting with '/' are prohibited) or an unreviewed runtime reference.

source_notebook_ref.description: Optional reference to a notebook that is the primary derivation source for this study. Include only when the study type produces derivation from a notebook. Informs pipeline/candidate-layout.schema.json#/properties/source_run traceability. Must be a safe, reviewable reference — absolute paths (starting with '/') are prohibited, and paths containing runtime-generated content or private directories must not be used.

authoring_generation_id.description: Project Spec S0167. Optional identifier of the single, immutable Atlas authoring generation (pipeline/dataset-integration-authoring-manifest.schema.json#/properties/authoring_generation/properties/authoring_generation_id) this source-contract input is capability-aware over. Present only together with authoring_manifest_ref, capability_profile_id, capability_profile_version, and capability_profile_ref (all five or none).

authoring_manifest_ref.description: Project Spec S0167. Optional governed reference (path + SHA-256) to the dataset-integration authoring manifest (pipeline/dataset-integration-authoring-manifest.schema.json) that governs this source-contract input's capability-aware role resolution. Never embeds the manifest's own payload -- semantic intent, source verification, preparation policy, and modeled/runtime evidence are resolved by walking this referenced manifest's own role-keyed artifact_references, not duplicated as separate fields here.

capability_profile_id.description: Project Spec S0167. Optional stable architecture-level capability family identifier (pipeline/capability-profile.schema.json#/properties/capability_profile_id) governing this source-contract input's role applicability and projection eligibility. Must never be a dataset slug or dataset-specific identity. Present only together with authoring_generation_id, authoring_manifest_ref, capability_profile_version, and capability_profile_ref.

capability_profile_version.description: Project Spec S0167. Optional version of the resolved capability profile (pipeline/capability-profile.schema.json#/properties/capability_profile_version). Present only together with authoring_generation_id, authoring_manifest_ref, capability_profile_id, and capability_profile_ref.

capability_profile_ref.description: Project Spec S0167. Optional governed reference (path + SHA-256) to the concrete capability profile document identified by capability_profile_id/capability_profile_version, for integrity-bound resolution. Present only together with authoring_generation_id, authoring_manifest_ref, capability_profile_id, and capability_profile_version.
